description: C3.2 calibration/test detection content (NOT a Type-A structural fixture; ADR-0006 §D8 Type-B). Adds two rules that emit the EVIDENTIARY and PROCEDURAL evidence types the core pack (fixtures/phase1_core_rules.json, unmodified) does not, so the C3.2 corpus can exercise all four EvidenceType values through the real, unmodified detection/evidence pipeline. Tier-1 machinery only; no real-world detection-efficacy claim. Deterministic, single-Observation rules; no technique mapping (EVIDENTIARY = corroborating IOC/infrastructure artifact, PROCEDURAL = a specific procedure-level detail).
